usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.fine_tuning.checkpoints.permissions.delete("ft:gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18:org:weather:B7R9VjQd", "cp_zc4Q7MP6XxulcVzj4MZdwsAB")
pp result

fields.name: id
fields.description: The ID of the fine-tuned model checkpoint permission that was deleted.

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always "checkpoint.permission".

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether the fine-tuned model checkpoint permission was successfully deleted.
